elements.name: diagnoseBluetooth
elements.docstring:
Bluetooth Filter Diagnostic Tool

Run this in the DevTools console (Ctrl+Shift+I) when the app is running
to diagnose why Bluetooth devices aren't appearing.

Usage:
1. Open Command Center app
2. Open DevTools (Ctrl+Shift+I or F12)
3. Paste this entire script into the console
4. Run: await diagnoseBluetooth()

2. Run: await testAcceptAll()
